title: Action-orbit (F9) and lacunary-coset (F10) quantization are the SAME ⟨g^{b-a}⟩-coset action — Chai-Fan's K literally equals #lacBad/(coset size), routing the orbit lane into the Schur/esymm-vanishing framework
